# vendor

Third-party runtime files loaded by generated compositions. No CDN access at render time (CLAUDE.md 5, rule 3).
Exact versions, each folder keeps its own license.

| Folder | Version | License |
| ------ | ------- | ------- |
| `three/` | three.js 0.186.1 (`three.module.js`, `three.core.js`, selected addons) | MIT |
| `gsap/` | GSAP 3.15.0 (`gsap.min.js`) | GreenSock standard "no charge" license, not open source |
| `fonts/` | 15 font families | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
